main_text.p: & spiritualis retinere terrenum imperium in ipsius territorio. Quid? quod pene sit impossibile abducere Reges à sententia quam vident non improbari in Pontificiis à plurimis celebrioris notæ inter Protestantes, ut fue-runt in Belgio Grotius (si tamen Protestantibus accensendus est) at in Anglia Laudus, Mon-tacutus & Hamondus, qui arctè tenent & docent in suis scriptis, Papam alium esse ab Antichri-sto, imo nullatenus esse Antichristum seu ἀντιχρίστῳ[?] Christo: at nemo est de Protestantium do-ctoribus, qui non agnoscat Papam ædificasse, & etiamnum re-tinere imperium terrenum in Reges & nationes, sed fucatum & oblinitum vocabulis Potesta-tis Ecclesiasticæ & spiritualis, ne fraus dispalescat: unde liquidò

page.notes: The Greek word after "seu" is small and blurred; the reading ἀντιχρίστῳ is uncertain. The long s is rendered as a plain s throughout. The faint "Digitized by Google" watermark at the lower right is not transcribed.
